_comment: DUNGEON RUN global tuning. Ben: this file is the dial board. Every number here changes the feel of the whole game. Change one at a time and play a run.

run._guaranteeEventComment: true: the room every path passes through partway down (where the paths join) is always an event.

baseline._comment: Design yardstick. 1 energy should buy about this much. Anything better must cost something.

rewards._rarityComment: How often each rarity shows up in card rewards and the shop. Bigger number = more often.
rewards._eliteComment: Elites are the risk. These are the reward: better odds on the cards they offer, and a relic every time.
rewards._companionComment: Chance (0 to 1) that beating an elite frees a companion you can take with you.

map._comment: The shape of the dungeon. Paths split into lanes for braidLength nodes, then join again at one node, then split again. The node before the boss is a choice of Rest or Shop.
map._laneThemesComment: Each lane in a split gets its own character, so picking a lane means something. Weights: bigger number = more often. atLeastOne: the lane always has at least one of that kind of room (when one can go there).
map._extraLaneComment: When a split has more lanes than themes that fit there, the extra lanes get this theme.
map._joinComment: The single rooms where the lanes meet. The first one is always an event when run.guaranteeEvent is true.

palette._comment: Wet stone, torchlight, dirt. Dark base, warm accents.
